licenceRule: Everything unset.sh writes is AGPL-3.0-only. Code, fonts and other work we use from others keep their own licence.

repos.name: unset
repos.summary: The unset.sh app: web, admin, public API, indexer, media proxy, their database and deployment. Lives outside the organisation for now and will be largely rewritten, then wired to the repositories below by pinned releases.
owns: Every product rule and screen of unset.sh, and the data behind them
The sh.unset.* lexicon schemas (shared/lexicons/schemas/), the source of truth until the organisation takes it over
Deciding what to present: which data, who may see it, URLs, caching and removal
The app's architecture decision records (docs/human/decisions/)

notHere.what: Design tokens, fonts, the mark and icons
Preview images and embeds drawn from data
Ready-made profile layouts for AI-assisted setup
The chat app (unset.cc), once it moves
The PDS image and its customisation, once they move

uses.how: @unset-sh/brand at an exact version (after the rewrite)
@unset-sh/presentation at an exact version (after the rewrite)
the PDS image by pinned digest (after the move)

licence.current: AGPL-3.0-only, except shared/ and the lexicon schemas, which are MIT (ADR 0012)

repos.name: .github
repos.description: Organisation profile and community health files for unset.sh
repos.summary: The organisation's front page and this map.
owns: The organisation profile page (profile/README.md)
This map: repos.json, MAP.md and the daily check that compares them with GitHub
Community health files shared by every repository, when they are added

notHere.what: Code, docs or assets of any product
notHere.where: the repository that owns them, from this map

repos.name: brand
repos.description: unset.sh brand foundations: design tokens, fonts, the mark and icons
repos.summary: Fixed files that say what unset.sh looks like, as pinned copies of the design sheet. Ships the package @unset-sh/brand (data only) on GitHub Packages.
owns: Design tokens (colour, type, spacing), the two fonts, the mark and icons
Brand guidelines: how to use colour, type and the mark
source.json: the design sheet version and sha256 of every copied file

notHere.what: Anything drawn from data, such as link previews and share cards
Code that decides or serves anything
A file that is not in the design sheet yet

licence.current: None on main; the draft in brand#1 proposes MIT for files, OFL-1.1 for the fonts (third-party) and all rights reserved for the mark and icons

repos.name: presentation
repos.description: How unset.sh looks outside the app: preview images and embeds for profiles, posts and articles, rendered from supplied data
repos.summary: Templates and the one rendering path for preview images and embeds, with a gallery of hard cases. Ships @unset-sh/presentation on GitHub Packages; no running service.
owns: Templates for profile, post and article previews, one owner per template
Rendering supplied data into images and embeds
The gallery of hard cases each template must survive

notHere.what: Deciding what to show: data, visibility, URLs, caching, removal
Colours, fonts and the mark
A server or a queue that renders on request

repos.name: profile-recipes
repos.description: Ready-made profile layouts for unset.sh, with recipes an AI can follow to build yours.
repos.summary: Persona profile layouts (recipes) with a guide an AI assistant follows to build someone's profile, plus sample records checked against the lexicons.
owns: Recipes: recipe.json, GUIDE.md, sample records, assets and preview per persona
AGENTS.md: the rules an assistant follows when applying a recipe
The validator that checks recipes against a vendored lexicon snapshot and editor limits

notHere.what: The lexicon schemas themselves (lexicons/ here is a copy)
The profile editor and its limits (limits.json here is a mirror)

uses.how: lexicon schemas and editor limits, copied at a pinned commit

licence.current: MIT for tooling, CC0-1.0 for recipes and sample content

repos.name: docs
repos.summary: Every repository's human docs, aggregated, and the docs.unset.sh site built from them on GitHub Pages. Nothing here is written by hand: each source repository's CI pushes its own top folder. Waiting for its first push.
owns: One top folder per source repository, replaced only by that repository's docs job
The site build and GitHub Pages deploy for docs.unset.sh

notHere.what: Writing or editing docs

uses.how: pushes docs/human and docs/site into unset/ with its own deploy key

licence.current: None yet (empty); holds copies of other repositories' docs

repos.name: pds
repos.summary: The home for unset.sh's PDS image and everything that customises the PDS: the build on top of the official image, the theme for its sign-in and account pages, and their pins. Empty for now; until it moves, the image is built in the app repository (deployment/pds/).
owns: The first-party PDS image: built on the official bluesky-social/pds image, with its upstream source and package versions pinned
Customising the PDS: the theme for its sign-in and account pages, and any other change to the stock PDS

notHere.what: Running and deploying the PDS, and the process that holds its admin password (pds-admin)
Colours, fonts and the mark the theme uses

uses.how: theme colours and fonts at an exact version (after the move)

licence.current: None yet (empty); the official PDS it builds on is third-party and keeps its own licence

repos.name: lexicons
repos.summary: A one-way, read-only copy of the sh.unset.* lexicon schemas, pushed by the app's mirror job. Waiting for setup by the owner; the direction reverses later, when the organisation becomes the source of truth.
owns: The published copy of the sh.unset.* schemas, their docs and examples

notHere.what: Any edit to a schema
notHere.where: unset (shared/lexicons/schemas/); the mirror copies it here

uses.how: pushes the schemas with its own deploy key

licence.current: Planned MIT, copied from the app (ADR 0012)

repos.name: messaging
repos.summary: The private messaging product on unset.cc: one-to-one chat on Matrix today, later communities, channels, roles and voice. Plan drafted, awaiting approval; not created.
owns: The chat client and the door (the public process on unset.cc)
The admin service that alone holds the MAS credential
Messaging rules, the Matrix adapter and the Synapse policy module
The Synapse image and the reviewed Synapse and MAS configs
Its own database tables
@unset-sh/messaging-contract: the only thing the app pins

notHere.what: Identity and sign-in
Generic server code (HTTP kit, CSRF gate, egress guard, sealing)
Design tokens, fonts and icons
Deploying the whole stack
notHere.where: unset (until a deploy repository is decided)

notHere.what: Anything with product meaning
